description: Manages the client access settings of an existing Exchange Online mailbox (Get-CASMailbox / Set-CASMailbox) - which protocols the mailbox may be reached over. There is no New- or Remove-CASMailbox: this resource configures a mailbox it does not own, so destroying it leaves the settings in place unless revert_on_destroy is set.

identity.description: The mailbox to configure: a UPN, primary SMTP address, alias or GUID - anything Get-CASMailbox -Identity accepts. The mailbox must already exist. Deliberately not marked requires_replace; pointing this at a different mailbox is rejected by update.ps1 instead, because a requires_replace attribute would plan a destroy on the first apply after any terraform import.

revert_on_destroy.description: On destroy, restore Exchange Online's defaults for the settings this resource manages. Off by default, so `terraform destroy` drops the resource from state and leaves the mailbox's client access settings exactly as they are - which means hardening you applied here survives. Turn it on to have destroy undo those changes. Only settings actually configured on this resource are touched; see revert_values to override the default it restores.

revert_values.description: Overrides the built-in table of Exchange defaults used by revert_on_destroy, as a JSON object of Set-CASMailbox parameter names, e.g. jsonencode({ OwaMailboxPolicy = "Contoso-Default" }). Needed because the correct default for the policy-name settings is tenant-specific. This resource cannot snapshot the pre-existing values instead: computed attributes are not available to a destroy.

activesync_enabled.description: Allow Exchange ActiveSync (Set-CASMailbox -ActiveSyncEnabled). Exchange default: true.

owa_enabled.description: Allow Outlook on the web (Set-CASMailbox -OWAEnabled). Exchange default: true.

owa_for_devices_enabled.description: Allow the Outlook on the web mobile apps (Set-CASMailbox -OWAforDevicesEnabled). Exchange default: true.

mapi_enabled.description: Allow MAPI, which is how the Outlook desktop client connects (Set-CASMailbox -MAPIEnabled). Exchange default: true.

ews_enabled.description: Allow Exchange Web Services (Set-CASMailbox -EwsEnabled). When unset on the mailbox, Exchange falls back to the organisation-level setting.

pop_use_protocol_defaults.description: Use the organisation's POP3 protocol defaults for this mailbox (Set-CASMailbox -PopUseProtocolDefaults). Exchange default: true.

imap_use_protocol_defaults.description: Use the organisation's IMAP4 protocol defaults for this mailbox (Set-CASMailbox -ImapUseProtocolDefaults). Exchange default: true.

smtp_client_authentication_disabled.description: Disable authenticated SMTP (SMTP AUTH) for this mailbox (Set-CASMailbox -SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled). Leave unset on the mailbox to inherit the tenant-wide setting from Set-TransportConfig; that inherited state is what revert_on_destroy restores.

activesync_mailbox_policy.description: Name of the mobile device mailbox policy to apply (Set-CASMailbox -ActiveSyncMailboxPolicy). The policy must already exist.

owa_mailbox_policy.description: Name of the Outlook on the web mailbox policy to apply (Set-CASMailbox -OwaMailboxPolicy). The policy must already exist.

activesync_allowed_device_ids.description: Device IDs allowed to sync with this mailbox (Set-CASMailbox -ActiveSyncAllowedDeviceIDs). Authoritative: the list replaces whatever is configured.

activesync_blocked_device_ids.description: Device IDs blocked from syncing with this mailbox (Set-CASMailbox -ActiveSyncBlockedDeviceIDs). Authoritative: the list replaces whatever is configured.

ews_allow_outlook.description: Allow Outlook to use EWS against this mailbox (Set-CASMailbox -EwsAllowOutlook).

ews_allow_mac_outlook.description: Allow Outlook for Mac to use EWS against this mailbox (Set-CASMailbox -EwsAllowMacOutlook).

ews_application_access_policy.description: Whether ews_allow_list or ews_block_list governs EWS application access (Set-CASMailbox -EwsApplicationAccessPolicy).

ews_allow_list.description: EWS user-agent strings permitted when ews_application_access_policy is EnforceAllowList (Set-CASMailbox -EwsAllowList).

ews_block_list.description: EWS user-agent strings denied when ews_application_access_policy is EnforceBlockList (Set-CASMailbox -EwsBlockList).

additional_parameters.description: Escape hatch: a JSON object of extra Set-CASMailbox parameters, splatted onto the cmdlet after every attribute above and winning over them, e.g. jsonencode({ ShowGalAsDefaultView = false }). Terraform cannot validate these, they are not reflected in any computed attribute, and revert_on_destroy does not undo them.

external_directory_object_id.description: The mailbox's Entra ID object ID.

effective_primary_smtp_address.description: Primary SMTP address of the mailbox this resource configures. Useful for confirming identity resolved to what you expected.

effective_display_name.description: Display name of the mailbox this resource configures.

effective_activesync_enabled.description: ActiveSync state as Exchange currently reports it. Config attributes are never refreshed, so these mirrors are how drift becomes visible.

effective_owa_enabled.description: Outlook on the web state as Exchange currently reports it.

effective_pop_enabled.description: POP3 state as Exchange currently reports it.

effective_imap_enabled.description: IMAP4 state as Exchange currently reports it.

effective_mapi_enabled.description: MAPI state as Exchange currently reports it.

effective_ews_enabled.description: EWS state as Exchange currently reports it; null when the mailbox inherits the organisation setting.

effective_smtp_client_authentication_dis.description: SMTP AUTH state as Exchange currently reports it; null when the mailbox inherits the tenant-wide setting.

effective_activesync_mailbox_policy.description: Mobile device mailbox policy currently applied.

effective_owa_mailbox_policy.description: Outlook on the web mailbox policy currently applied.

effective_activesync_blocked_device_ids.description: Device IDs Exchange currently blocks from syncing with this mailbox.

effective_activesync_allowed_device_ids.description: Device IDs Exchange currently allows to sync with this mailbox.
